messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當你把球「直線往上」拋出，除了重力之外（假設忽略空氣阻力、地面摩擦等），它在運動過程中所受的唯一外部作用是重力。  
因此：

| 設定 | 加速度 |
|------|--------|
| 上升方向為正（即 \(+y\)） | \(-g ≈ -9.8\,\text{m/s}^{2}\) |

也就是說，在任何時刻，球都會受到約 **\(9.8~\mathrm{m/s^{2}}\)** 的下落加速度；若用上方作正方向，那就寫成負值。

> *注意*：這裡沒有考慮空氣阻力或其他外力，只是假設理想情況下只存在重力。  

所以答案簡單來說：「其加速度始終保持大約 \(-9.8~\mathrm{m/s^{2}}\)，指向地下。」
message.reasoning:
The user asks (in Chinese): "If a ball is thrown upward at speed of 5 m/s directly up, what acceleration will it achieve?" They likely mean what's its acceleration? In physics, when throwing upward, the only acceleration acting on the ball after launch is gravitational acceleration downward (~ -9.81 m/s^2). So answer: acceleration constant downward ~ -9.8 m/s².

But maybe they want to compute max height using given tool? But question says "what acceleration" not height. Might ask incorrectly; but we can respond explaining acceleration remains constant equal to g downwards regardless of initial velocity. Provide explanation and optionally use tool to compute something else? Not needed.

We should also mention sign convention: upward positive so acceleration negative. Also note no other forces considered.

Thus produce answer accordingly.
